headline: Computer Science student at Aalto University
summary: First-year Computer Science student in Espoo who builds data and web projects at hackathons. At Junction 2026 my team placed 1st in the Oxylabs tech track and 3rd in the Hostinger main track; in September we won IBM's Best Use of IBM Bob prize at the AaltoAI hackathon. I use AI coding assistants as part of how I build.
